result.title: Learning to Be Guided: Shaping Latent Geometry for Classifier-Free Guidance
result.summary: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is a standard component of conditional diffusion models, and guided generation performance has become the \textit{de facto} measure of state-of-the-art models. Recent work on latent diffusion models seeks to learn latent spaces that are easier to model with diffusion. However, under CFG, generation additionally depends on how conditions are arranged in the latent space. We study this arrangement under discrete class conditions, termed \emph{class geometry}, and investigate what class geometry allows a latent space to work well with CFG. Under a Gaussian class model, we show that shifting variance from intra- to inter-class at fixed total variance makes classes more distinguishable under noise, and derive a noisy posterior objective whose per-sample descent direction is proportional to the oracle CFG correction. Based on the analysis, we propose Prototype Regularization (PR), a lightweight surrogate for the intractable noisy posterior objective, which applies a cosine prototype classifier to spatially pooled latents. With a controlled training budget (20 epochs for VAE, 80 epochs for DiT), adding PR to an LDM baseline reduces guided gFID on ImageNet from 3.31 to 2.28, surpassing a DINOv3-aligned VA-VAE (2.44) with negligible overhead. We further demonstrate that PR generalizes to pseudo-labels derived from clustering, continuous text-embedding conditions, and video latents. Together, our findings highlight class geometry as a critical factor in guided generation and take a first step toward CFG-compatible representation learning. Our project page is available at: https://maps-research.github.io/cfg-geometry/.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究扩散模型中类别条件在 latent 空间的排布方式（「class geometry」）：在高斯类别模型下分析类间/类内方差分配对噪声下可分性的影响，推导 noisy posterior 目标，并据此提出 Prototype Regularization，以提升 CFG 引导生成质量。
AI.relevance_reason: 其关于 latent 空间中类别几何与噪声下可分性的分析、以及空间池化表征上的原型正则，可能启发 LVR 中「任务必要视觉信息是否在内部状态中保持可分」的表征几何与训练监督问题，可供核查。
